critical_quality_flaws: Zero validation instances for 5 out of 6 classes (BIODEGRADABLE, CARDBOARD, GLASS, METAL, PAPER) in val split.
Zero test instances for CARDBOARD in test split.
Extreme class imbalance: PLASTIC comprises 63.6% of all annotated boxes.

quality_gate_decision.production_impact: best.pt is preserved intact. Experimental training stopped to prevent deploying a crippled, plastic-biased detector.
